executive.text: Orders is a small, business-critical Struts application with 4 services and 4 screens. It runs on end-of-life libraries with critical vulnerabilities. A three-wave migration to Spring Boot, Angular and Cloud SQL is estimated at 37 to 129 person-days (likely 68).

architect.text: One WAR with JSP, Struts actions, a JDBC DAO and a PL/SQL pricing package. The target splits it into an Angular UI and a Spring Boot API on Cloud Run with Cloud SQL.
key_messages: Pricing logic moves from PL/SQL to Java

functional.text: Agents keep the same steps: log in, search, open an order. Login moves to the corporate single sign-on and pages become faster.

developer.text: Rewrite the 3 Struts actions as REST endpoints, replace concatenated SQL with bind parameters, and port PKG_ORDER_PRICING with golden tests.
